question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**inadequate**" means lacking the quality or quantity required; insufficient. (अपर्याप्त)
 
• Paddy farmers suffering from moisture stress implies that the rainfall was not sufficient, making "inadequate rainfall" the appropriate choice.
 
• The other options: "**round**," "**adept**," and "**plenty**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** Paddy farmers in Odisha have already been suffering from moisture stress due to **inadequate**__ rainfall in Ganjam and Gajapati districts, while pest attacks have been reported in western Odisha districts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Round **(गोल): Shaped like or approximately like a circle or cylinder.

 
 
• **Example:** The table has a round shape.
 
 
 
• **Adept **(कुशल): Very skilled or proficient at something.
 
 
• **Example:** She is adept at playing the violin.
 
 
 
• **Plenty **(बहुतायत): A large or sufficient amount or quantity; more than enough.
 
 
• **Example:** We have plenty of food for the party.
